our_father.title: Pater Noster
phrases: Pater noster, qui es in caelis,
sicut in caelo et in terra.
Panem nostrum cotidianum da nobis hodie,
sicut et nos dimittimus debitoribus nostris.
Et ne nos inducas in tentationem,
sed libera nos a malo. Amen.

hail_mary.title: Ave Maria
phrases: et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.

glory_be.title: Gloria Patri
phrases: Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper,

fatima.title: Oratio Fatimae
phrases: O mi Iesu, dimitte nobis debita nostra,
quae misericordiae tuae maxime indigent. Amen.

hail_holy_queen.title: Salve Regina
phrases: vita, dulcedo, et spes nostra, salve.
Ad te clamamus exsules filii Hevae,
ad te suspiramus, gementes et flentes in hac lacrimarum valle.
Eia, ergo, advocata nostra, illos tuos misericordes oculos ad nos converte,
et Iesum, benedictum fructum ventris tui, nobis post hoc exsilium ostende.
O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo Maria.
Ora pro nobis, Sancta Dei Genetrix, ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.

eternal_father.title: Pater Aeterne
phrases: Pater Aeterne, offero Tibi Corpus et Sanguinem,
Animam et Divinitatem dilectissimi Filii Tui,

holy_god.title: Sanctus Deus
phrases: Sanctus Deus, Sanctus Fortis, Sanctus Immortalis,
miserere nobis et totius mundi. Amen.

hail_joseph.title: Ave Ioseph
phrases: Ave Ioseph, fili David, vir iustissime,
Sancta Maria, Virgo Deipara, sponsa tua tecum.
ora pro nobis nunc et in hora mortis nostrae. Amen.

sacred_heart_large.title: Offering to the Sacred Heart
phrases: O Most Sacred Heart of Jesus,
fount of all love and mercy,
and make our hearts like unto Thine.

sacred_heart_small.title: Aspiration to the Sacred Heart
phrases: Jesus, meek and humble of heart,
make my heart like unto Thine.

holy_wounds_father.title: Offering of the Holy Wounds
phrases: Eternal Father, I offer Thee the Wounds of Our Lord Jesus Christ,
to heal the wounds of our souls.

holy_wounds_bead.title: Invocation of the Holy Wounds
phrases: through the merits of Thy Holy Wounds.

precious_blood_bead.title: Invocation of the Most Precious Blood
phrases: save us and the whole world.

saint_anne_bead.title: Invocation of Saint Anne
phrases: grant me your holy protection and bless me.
